scope: Read-only resource/codebook reconnaissance and bounded acquisition; no event-rate fitting, outcome comparison, raw republication or contact.

primary_sources.article_license: Creative Commons Attribution, as stated by publisher.

primary_sources.article_license: CC BY 4.0; third-party exceptions apply if separately credited. No contrary notice identified in the acquired workbook or its dictionary.

primary_sources.availability: Generic p53Cinema is linked; additional custom MATLAB code is available on request. No machine-readable event deposit located in the inspected article/supplement inventory.
primary_sources.article_license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 after the publisher embargo; this does not establish availability or separate permission for an absent event dataset.

iyer_code_reconnaissance.method: GitHub connector repository searches: user:Shaonlab; persister user:Shaonlab; Iyer persister. Focused paper-title/author web searches also checked.
iyer_code_reconnaissance.scope_limit: Search results are a bounded observed inventory, not proof that unpublished/private/unindexed code does not exist.
iyer_code_reconnaissance.other_access_results: GitHub account repositories web tab unavailable to web fetch; a direct search endpoint was rejected by the connector URL schema. No alternate access was used to circumvent that rejection.
iyer_code_reconnaissance.code_license: No study-specific public code located, so no study-specific code licence certified.

hct116.decision: GO for event/tree reconstruction and structural eligibility audit; conditional hold on inferential modeling.
hct116.cell_line: HCT116 p53-Venus / p53-VKI with H2B-ECFP; colorectal cancer cell line, not EGFR-mutant lung cancer.

dictionary_fields.rows: 394 tracked-cell rows with shared ancestral histories; not 394 independent founders.
dictionary_fields.Divisions: 1 means division at that timepoint; 0 means no division.
dictionary_fields.p53: p53-Venus measurement; -1 denotes not tracked, due either to death or ambiguous identity at the beginning.
dictionary_fields.Lineage: Shared numeric labels at a frame identify a common tracked cell/history; splitting labels mark divisions. Zero means not tracked. An unchanged label alone does not rule out division.
dictionary_fields.parent_id: No explicit parent-ID column. A biological event/parent table must be reconstructed from lineage splits and division indicators; one descendant can retain the prior label.
dictionary_fields.replicate_id: No movie, field, well, experiment or replicate field in the four arrays.
dictionary_fields.treatment_arm: One source-described cisplatin trajectory; no per-row arm column or multiple-dose table.

time_and_treatment.dictionary_unit_extraction_note: The DOCX micro symbol is stored as Symbol-font character F06D; naive text extraction drops it. Unit agrees with primary paper.
time_and_treatment.status: Workbook-specific codebook is more precise, but 49-hour/frame98 versus main-text50-hour discrepancy and first-frame/event-boundary convention must remain explicit; no silent alignment correction.

known_source_selection.other_exclusions: 13 never-dividing founder lineages; some later enter and some die, so this is outcome-related selection.
known_source_selection.limit: These are published exclusion labels, not independently reconstructed tree identities or a repaired population denominator.

hct116.censoring: Explicit -1 and zero tracking conventions are helpful, but the dictionary does not provide a separate per-episode lost-track, administrative-end or complete-family flag. Parent reconstruction and missing-branch checks are required.
hct116.replication_limit: The original article reports two experiments in parts of its analysis, but no row-to-experiment mapping is supplied in this workbook. Multiple tracked cells do not supply independent experimental replication.
hct116.reuse_assessment: Article-associated workbook/dictionary are publicly supplied under the original CC BY 4.0 framework absent a separately credited exception. Attribute source, describe transformations and retain originals. This audit publishes metadata and links only; no raw file or third-party code is mirrored.
required_next_structural_checks: Reconstruct unique biological cell episodes, splitting an inherited label at every division, and deduplicate repeated ancestor histories.
Verify each division has the expected daughter relationships and event timing; list orphan, merging or abruptly appearing identities instead of fixing them silently.
Cross-check apoptosis flags, p53 -1 entries and lineage-zero masks; retain contradictions and uncertain loss as distinct states.
Build an eligible-founder roster with baseline presence, delayed entry and complete post-treatment follow-up indicators, without selecting by survival or division count.
Map and report the original 18 exclusions, with never-divider inclusion sensitivity distinct from missing-identity exclusions.

Resolve frame98 alignment, the codebook49-hour versus main-methods50-hour timing, and division/death boundary conventions; otherwise carry prespecified treatment-origin and one-frame event-boundary sensitivities.
Determine whether any provenance source can recover independent experiment/field IDs; otherwise keep all inference within this recorded experiment.

u2os.decision: NO_GO for full-tree empirical validation from currently located public files.
u2os.tracking: One randomly selected daughter per division; the untracked sister subtree is absent by design.

located_files.name: mbc-31-845-s001.pdf
located_files.role: Supplementary figures/count tables, not a deposited normalized event table verified here.
located_files.access_check: PMC attachment returned a browser-check page; publisher supplemental URL returned403. Contents not certified in this audit.

located_files.role: Example movies; not equivalent to lineage/event records, and not downloaded.

u2os.missing: Reusable event file/accession, exact per-cell/frame dictionary, identity/parent fields, tracking/censoring roster, replicate links and dataset-specific reuse terms. Even with single-tag events, family extinction of an untracked full tree cannot be recovered.

existing_analyses_to_avoid_repackaging: Chakrabarti2018: division/death timing correlations, sister-fate and p53 associations, competing-risk/copula inference and an oscillatory lineage model.
Granada2020: proliferation/cell-cycle features versus cisplatin outcome and information-theoretic interactions.

Iyer2025: cycling-mixture analysis, population-decay fits, age-structured and inherited-state alternatives, competing-risk inference, lineage-fate correlation, barcode-diversity simulation and repeated random-daughter sampling for a Luria-Delbruck statistic.

one_concrete_proposed_test.status: PROPOSAL_ONLY; no empirical outcome fit or performance score computed.
one_concrete_proposed_test.question: Can a model trained on prospective event histories predict held-out families’ endpoint survival and the death-time distribution after conditioning those families on endpoint survival, without introducing inherited latent states?
one_concrete_proposed_test.purpose: Test transport of a sampling-aware baseline to a withheld ascertainment design, not the algebraic Qh identity and not a repeat of published lineage-correlation or population-slope fits.
one_concrete_proposed_test.primary_data: HCT116 full trees only, after reconstruction/censoring gates. Keep entire founder families together in training/test partitions.
one_concrete_proposed_test.baseline: An observed cause-specific event model with cell age and time since treatment; both division and death use a common observable risk set and administrative/loss censoring is explicit. No latent counterfactual failure-time claim.
one_concrete_proposed_test.comparison: An inherited-family effect or documented inherited-state model with the same observed-event likelihood and equally prespecified flexibility; a constant-rate branching model is an additional restricted reference.
target_measurements: Held-out family survival at fixed post-treatment landmarks, suggested 24/48/72 hours pending certified frame map
Held-out conditional random-forward-tag death-time distribution among endpoint-surviving families
Calibration and proper predictive score, with uncertainty clustered by original founder and branch sampling integrated or repeated with fixed seeds
analysis_commitments: Freeze eligibility, endpoint, model complexity, split seed and scoring before outcome fitting.
Use a hierarchy-aware split: entire family in one fold; no duplicated ancestor event in both training and testing.
Compare the actual selected distribution to predictions; do not call Qhat*hhat=tag_survivors/all_founders an empirical model test because it is an accounting identity.
Report all-founder versus published never-divider-excluded sensitivity, delayed-entry handling and one-frame timing sensitivity.
Report all-founder versus published never-divider-excluded sensitivity, delayed-entry handling, the 49-hour versus 50-hour treatment-origin difference and one-frame event-boundary sensitivity.
one_concrete_proposed_test.interpretation: A successful baseline challenges the need for additional latent-state structure for this prediction; a failure does not uniquely establish memory, because unobserved heterogeneity, environmental effects or censoring misspecification remain alternatives. Small single-experiment data cannot establish cross-experiment generalization.
one_concrete_proposed_test.novelty_status: Unestablished; proposed incremental predictive/design test, with focused prior-art review required before a novelty claim.

bottom_line: The HCT116 pair supplies actual small reusable event/lineage arrays with a source dictionary and a favourable reuse framework. It is a concrete reconstruction target, not yet a complete normalized event table with verified replication and censoring. Iyer-specific code and U2OS event data were not located in the inspected public sources.
